entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where the ten guilds compete for power.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The guild of justice and martial zeal, led by Aurelia, whose angels and soldiers fight for justice.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The guild of law and order, which fights for law and funds Boros nav squads.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The guild of wealth, debt and religion, served by thrulls, whose clergy collect tribute.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The guild of spies and deception, led by Lazav and served by shades.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The guild of savage clans of the wilds and ruins, led by Borborygmos.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The guild of biomancers who breed krasis and fuse life essences.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild of fire and invention led by the dragon Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The guild of nature and harmony, with Trostani among its figures.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The guild of rot and decay; Gurras is a Golgari rot farmer.

entities.name: Rakdos Cult
entities.description: The guild of hedonism and carnage whose revues mock, defile and kill.

entities.name: Gateless Movement
entities.description: A movement of guildless rebels who defy the ten guilds.

entities.name: Obzedat
entities.description: The dead ruling council of the Orzhov, described as mainly lazy and dead.

entities.name: Burning-Tree Clan
entities.description: A Gruul clan whose enemies respect Borborygmos's rule.

entities.name: Ghor-Clan
entities.description: A Gruul clan led by chieftain Ruric Thar.

entities.name: Slizt Clan
entities.description: A Gruul clan of viashino known for its battle cry.

entities.name: Bolrac Clan
entities.description: A Gruul clan of ogres that picks fights with buildings.

entities.name: Hull Clade
entities.description: A Simic clade to which Vorel belongs.

entities.name: Skyjeks
entities.description: Skyjek scouts patrol the skies of Ravnica.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: Boros angel and warleader who is on the frontlines calling for war and who denounced Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who is taught by Aurelia and speaks to her of inner strength.

entities.name: Razia
entities.description: Former Boros leader, described as aloof and untouchable.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: Dimir guildmaster who schemes against the Boros and Izzet.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Izzet dragon who researches a hidden path and protects it from others.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Grand Envoy of the Orzhov.

entities.name: Milana
entities.description: Orzhov prelate.

entities.name: Jozica
entities.description: Orzhov enforcer.

entities.name: Zelinas
entities.description: Orzhov recruiter.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: Selesnya figure who sought the future in the whispers of the past.

entities.name: Borborygmos
entities.description: Gruul leader whose rule is respected even by enemies.

entities.name: Ruric Thar
entities.description: Ghor-Clan chieftain of the Gruul.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: Planeswalker who sides with the Gruul.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Izzet planeswalker who sees countless worlds.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who writes a journal about the maze.

entities.name: Prime Speaker Zegana
entities.description: Simic Prime Speaker.

entities.name: Speaker Trifon
entities.description: A Simic speaker.

entities.name: Vorel
entities.description: Simic of the Hull Clade.

entities.name: Nikya of the Old Ways
entities.description: Gruul figure opposed to the city's laws.

entities.name: Nedja
entities.description: Gruul shaman.

entities.name: Kroshkar
entities.description: Gruul shaman.

entities.name: Narbulg Nine Fingers
entities.description: A fighter who speaks of taking down dragons.

entities.name: Dars Gostok
entities.description: Izzet Firefist captain.

entities.name: Libuse
entities.description: Boros sergeant.

entities.name: Commander Yaszen
entities.description: Boros commander.

entities.name: Arrester Lavinia
entities.description: Arrester of the Tenth Precinct.

entities.name: Janik Bara
entities.description: Wojek captain.

entities.name: Strava
entities.description: Dimir mage.

entities.name: Firemane Nevena
entities.description: Boros officer who led the assault on the Barbu Rooftop rebels and is marked for death by the Gateless.

entities.name: Predak
entities.description: Gateless freemage.

entities.name: Briska
entities.description: Ninth District freemage.

entities.name: Fblthp
entities.description: A lost homunculus who hates crowds.

entities.name: Barbu Rooftop
entities.description: Site of a battle between the Boros and rebels.

entities.name: Millennium Platform
entities.description: Once a monument to peace, seized by the skyknights.

entities.name: Sunhome
entities.description: Boros location topped by Izzet-designed conductors.

events.summary: The Boros built a prison in the sky out of the reach of Azorius statutes.
events.quote: The Boros built a prison in the sky where Azorius statutes couldn't restrict their sense of justice.

events.summary: Aurelia tells Gideon Jura he must first fight among the rank and file so she can discern his skills.
events.quote: First, you must fight among the rank and file.

events.summary: Boros troops lost the respect of the citizens after the battle for Barbu Rooftop.
events.quote: We lost respect after the battle for Barbu Rooftop.

events.summary: Firemane Nevena led the victorious assault on the Barbu Rooftop rebels, and the Gateless marked her for death.
events.quote: Firemane Nevena led the victorious assault on the Barbu Rooftop rebels.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet moved to keep others from the path he sought.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet took steps to prevent others from approaching it.

events.summary: Lazav stalled Niv-Mizzet's experiments until his intentions were known.
events.quote: Lazav took every opportunity to stall his experiments.

events.summary: Aurelia denounced Niv-Mizzet, ending the Warmind Initiative collaboration between Boros and Izzet.
events.quote: Before Aurelia denounced Niv-Mizzet, the two guilds had collaborated on the Warmind Initiative

events.summary: Trostani sought the future in the whispers of the past while Lazav schemed and Niv-Mizzet researched.
events.quote: While Lazav schemed and Niv-Mizzet researched, Trostani sought the future in the whispers of the past.

events.summary: Skyknights seized Millennium Platform for its strategic location.
events.quote: Millennium Platform, once a monument to peace, was quickly seized by the skyknights

events.summary: Giant sinkholes opened across Ravnica, revealing buried oceans and merfolk.
events.quote: When giant sinkholes opened across Ravnica, they revealed buried oceans and the merfolk, once thought to be extinct.

events.summary: The Rakdos unleashed hellraiser goblins against Boros interference.
events.quote: Tired of Boros interference, the Rakdos unleashed hellraiser goblins

events.summary: Borborygmos's elemental launched an assault on the Izzet in the Rubblebelt but the wards held.
events.quote: Borborygmos's elemental launched an assault, but the Izzet wards held and experiments continue.

events.summary: The Boros are losing their angels to the Gateless Movement.
events.quote: I hear that Boros is losing its angels to the Gateless Movement.

relations.note: Aurelia is the Boros warleader, replacing Razia.
relations.quote: Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.

relations.note: Aurelia instructs Gideon in how to prove himself.
relations.quote: I will discern your skills as a leader.
Dangerous to recognize. Deadly not to.
Even the bitterest enemies of the Burning-Tree Clan respect the strength of Borborygmos's rule.

relations.note: Ruric Thar is the Ghor-Clan chieftain.
relations.quote: Our fight is not about territory or revenge.
The Gruul embrace all things poisonous and living in the cracks of society.
You may not be able to pay. But you can still kneel.

relations.note: The Azorius fund Boros nav squads.
relations.quote: Funded by the Azorius to keep current maps of the undercity

relations.note: The Gateless have marked her for death.
relations.quote: Now the Gateless have marked her for death.
